Our Approach

Private Pet Care for
Orange County Families

I provide trusted in home pet care for families who want reliable and personalized attention while they're away. With over four years of pet hospitality experience, I focus on keeping every pet comfortable, safe, and happy in their normal environment.

I specialize in caring for senior dogs, dogs with special needs, medication routines, veterinary visits, and pets that require extra attention.

About Me

A Trusted Hand
in Your Home

Hi there! I bring years of hands on experience caring for dogs of all ages, sizes, and needs, including my own husky and several senior dogs requiring medical support and veterinary visits.

Throughout my life I've owned and loved five dogs. I understand the importance of treating every pet like family and providing care that matches their normal routine.

Beyond pet care, I've also been trusted to look after luxury homes throughout Coto de Caza, Dove Canyon, Ladera Ranch, Irvine, and Newport. For over four years I managed weekly household needs while coordinating with maids, landscapers, pool services, and other vendors.

Whether it's keeping up with energetic dogs, providing extra care for senior pets, or making sure your home remains secure while you're away, you can count on me to handle everything with reliability and professionalism.

My Promise

No Request Is Too Big

One client came to me because her dog needed more than a quick walk around the block — she was looking for someone who could run and walk him anywhere from 2 to 5 miles a day, rain or shine, while she was at work. She didn't just want her dog looked after. She wanted him to keep living his best life, full of energy, even when she couldn't be the one out there with him.

That's the standard I hold every request to. Whatever your pet needs — long runs, multiple daily visits, a strict medication schedule, extra reassurance for a senior dog — I'll build the plan around them, not the other way around.

No request is too big.
